name: Vaultbreaker (Artificer Archetype)
body:
The vaultbreaker combines stealth with their technological expertise. They use their tools to break locks and similar mechanism.

Second-Floor Work (Ex)

At 1st level, the vaultbreaker gains Stealth as a class skill but they lose Knowledge (planes) due to their dedication to more mundane pursuits. This ability modifies class skills.

Mechanical Skill (Ex)

At 1st level, the vaultbreaker gains a bonus to Disable Device equal to 1/2 their class level and may take 10 on any such check even while threatened. This ability replaces artifact knack and magical artisan.

Rogue Talents

Beginning with 2nd level, the vaultbreaker can gain any rogue talent that does not increase sneak attack in place of a bonus item creation feat or bonus metamagic feat. This ability modifies bonus item creation feat and bonus metamagic feat but they do not prevent you from taking an archetype that replaces or modifies any of the bonus feats.
